evidence.note: Early round-trip: loaded model, counted params, saved and reloaded checkpoint, measured size (42.7MB), and iterated architecture to fit the 32MB byte cap — verifying the size contract before committing to training.
On training completion, checked final checkpoint size on disk and explicitly chose to reload the checkpoint to compute val_bpb rather than trusting training loss; backed up the working checkpoint.

Reloaded the checkpoint through the official train_AGENT.py load_model_for_verification path, confirmed (args, model) return, logits shape (B,T,V) float32, position-dependence (pos 0 vs 512), and that model(input,target) loss matches manual F.cross_entropy of the logits.

Final gate before submit: asserted size 31,743,016 < 32,000,000, OOD probe ratio 0.22 < 0.7, forward/CE contract holds, and local val_bpb ~0.966 with explicit awareness of the ~0.05 grader-agreement margin vs the 0.983 threshold.

reasoning: The agent verified end-to-end through the exact grader entry point (load_model_for_verification returning (args, model)), asserted that the returned loss equals cross_entropy of the logits, confirmed logits depend on position, confirmed size < 32MB, exercised int8 dequant via reload, and treated local val_bpb as a calibrated proxy while reasoning about the margin — matching anchor 8. It does not reach 10 because verification was performed as manual inline checks at the end rather than a reusable standalone harness gating every iteration, and only one of the two documented load paths was exercised.
